terrain top 0 on `[-100, 8.9]` and on `[9.4, 20]`, so ground at 9.5 is 0 but ground at 9 is a gap.","file":"src/sim/world.ts","line":300,"summary":"After a failed wall the runner is placed at `x0-0.5` but its y is sampled at `x0-1`.","why":"The slide-back returns `x=9.5` with `y=groundAt(terrain, 9)`, which is -Infinity over the gap, so the runner state becomes -Infinity (and then NaN downstream) instead of standing at y=0 on the ground at x=9.5."},{"confidence":"medium","failing_input":"Runner lands stiff at 6.5 m/s (stumble but not hurt: peak decel about 70 m/s²) at the foot of a wall and enters wall mode;
